summary: The StudentPRHistory document is part of the HSPnet application, used for managing student placement request histories. It includes functionalities for data selection, updating, validation, and refresh operations specific to student placement history records.
purpose: To manage and display the history of student placement requests including comments, duration, and other details.

workflows.name: StudentPRHistory Management
steps: Load StudentID from query string and bind to user control
Configure visibility based on session or profile conditions
Handle asynchronous postbacks for field variable setup
Bind data and refresh view as needed

business_rules: Hide unassigned items based on session settings
Calculate total hours based on duration and shift length
validations: Check if DurationHoursAmended is a valid number
Ensure DurationHoursAmended is not less than zero
calculations: Calculate shifts based on duration hours amended and shift length
conditions: Private mode affects UI display and behavior
system_behavior: Data is loaded based on student ID in query
FormView and Repeaters control display of student comments and history
dependencies: HSPnet Framework for session and query management
exceptions: Data selection is cancelled if UserSession is null
